g.text: Matched GIANT/RR inputs · 100 ms observation · 1200-byte packets · 2.5 Gb/s uplink
Points show the mean of three seeds. Whiskers span the seed min–max.
8 Gb/s T4-only input · Configured T1 fixed windows retained
B · Protected services under T4 overload
8 SFUs · T4 at 8 Gb/s relative to the matched T4 = 0 baseline
2 SFUs · 3.05 Gb/s total input · SImax = 1 frame · ABmin per SFU
D · T2 service interval and polling sensitivity
2 SFUs · 3.05 Gb/s total input · Same nominal GIANT rate for SI1 and SI2
FIFO wait runs from entry to optical loading. Packets still waiting at 100 ms are censored. The panels use different scales.
